title: Structure–activity relationships of Cu–ZrO2 catalysts for CO2 hydrogenation to methanol: interaction effects and reaction mechanism
extraction_notes: No main-text figures contain plotted CO2 conversion, CH3OH/CO/CH4 selectivity, or methanol STY/formation-rate values. The only main-text catalytic performance numbers for these metrics are printed in Table 2. Figure 7e was skipped because it plots normalized DRIFTS peak intensity of gaseous CH3OH bands versus time, not a reported methanol STY or formation rate. Figure 8b was skipped because it plots normalized formate (HCOO) intensity, and Figure 9b plots acid-site intensities; these are mechanistic/characterisation quantities rather than requested catalytic performance metrics.
